_comment: Static fallback, GENERATED from ../adaptive/quickshell/theme.json with the base Ionix palette. Installed when there is no wallpaper to read, no matugen, or a template that failed to render. It is also the file services/Themes.qml reads for this theme's preview swatch in the start menu picker, so it must stay valid JSON — the picker shows these colours rather than the live wallpaper-derived ones. Edit the template and re-render rather than editing here.

theme._comment: Exactly the keys config/Theme.qml reads, and no more. barFill, panelFill, pillFill, pillBorder, barBorder, panelBorder and divider are all derived from these inside Theme.qml — emitting them here would freeze relationships the shell is meant to compute. accentBright is the load-bearing one: barBorder and panelBorder are both alpha() of it. The font keys are deliberately absent so they inherit the shipped Nerd Font, which every module renders its glyphs with.
